newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes firmer to mark, softer to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes firmer to mark, softer to dlr.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 994-995.30 per mark, slightly firmer from the opening's 994-996, after quiet interbank forex trade, dealers said.
* The lev fell to 1,740-1,744 per dollar from 1,732-1,735 in the morning, as traders adjusted the levels through the domestic lev/mark rate and the mark/dollar cross on international markets.
* Traders said there was a dollar-bullish sentiment on the local market shadowing the mark fall against the dollar on global markets.
* But again the main foreign currency bidder was the central bank, which bought marks at 995 levs, dealers said.
* Under the arrangement of the currency board, launched on Tuesday, the central bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited amounts of marks backed by a 2.8 billion mark gross foreign exchange reserve.
